finding.name: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')
finding.summary: userFile query parameter is combined into a path and canonicalized with Path.GetFullPath, but containment is checked with a bare fullPath.StartsWith(BaseDirectory) that a sibling directory sharing the same string prefix (e.g. C:\app\uploads-secret) passes, letting File.ReadAllBytes read files outside the intended uploads directory
